facts.text: Otis was founded in 1918 when Los Angeles Times publisher Harrison Gray Otis bequeathed his estate to the city to advance arts education.

sources.title: Otis College Experience | Handbook | Otis College of Art and Design
sources.quote: Otis College of Art and Design was founded in 1918, when General Harrison Gray Otis, publisher of the Los Angeles Times, bequeathed his MacArthur Park property to the City of Los Angeles for “the advancement of the arts.”
